nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the ambient space is the real Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ of dimension $n$, with coordinates indexed by $0, \dots, n-1$ and the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Ambient Euclidean space

nodes.summary: Let $f$ and $g$ be locally flat embedded $3$-spheres in $\mathbb{R}^4$, that is, continuous injective locally flat maps $S^3 \to \mathbb{R}^4$ from the unit sphere. Suppose that the images of $f$ and $g$ are disjoint and that the image of $g$ lies in the inside of the image of $f$, the set of points off the image of $f$ whose connected component in its complement is bounded. nodes.title: Annulus theorem in dimension four

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 5$ and let $f$ and $g$ be locally flat embedded $(n-1)$-spheres in $\mathbb{R}^n$, that is, continuous injective locally flat maps $S^{n-1} \to \mathbb{R}^n$ from the unit sphere. Suppose that the images of $f$ and $g$ are disjoint and that the image of $g$ lies in the inside of the image of $f$, the set of points off the image of $f$ whose connected component in its complement is bounded. Then the…
nodes.title: Annulus theorem in dimensions at least five

nodes.summary: For $n \ge 1$, a locally flat embedded $(n-1)$-sphere in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is a map $f : S^{n-1} \to \mathbb{R}^n$ from the unit sphere that is continuous, injective and locally flat.
nodes.title: Locally flat embedded sphere

nodes.summary: For a set $S \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, the inside of $S$ is the set of points $x \notin S$ whose connected component in the complement $\mathbb{R}^n \setminus S$ is bounded.
nodes.title: Inside of a set

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$, let $S^{n-1} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ be the unit sphere and let $H = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^n : x_0 = 0\}$ be the model hyperplane. A map $c : S^{n-1} \to \mathbb{R}^n$ is locally flat if for every point $p \in S^{n-1}$ there are open sets $U, V \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ with $c(p) \in U$ and a homeomorphism $h : U \to V$ such that $h(U \cap c(S^{n-1})) = V \cap H$.
nodes.title: Locally flat maps of the sphere

nodes.summary: For $n \ge 1$, the model hyperplane in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is the set of points $x = (x_0, \dots, x_{n-1})$ whose first coordinate $x_0$ is $0$. It is the local model for a locally flat embedded sphere.
nodes.title: Model hyperplane

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $f$ and $g$ be locally flat embedded $(n-1)$-spheres in $\mathbb{R}^n$. The region between $f$ and $g$ is the closure of the inside of the image of $f$ with the inside of the image of $g$ removed, where the inside of a set $S$ is the set of points $x \notin S$ whose connected component in $\mathbb{R}^n \setminus S$ is bounded.
nodes.title: Region between two flat spheres

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the unit sphere $S^{n-1} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ is the set of points of $\mathbb{R}^n$ at Euclidean distance $1$ from the origin.
nodes.title: Unit sphere in Euclidean space

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
